title: Resend feature card
description: A product visual in a hairline box with 24px top corners whose sides and contents fade into the black page, lit by a grey glow at its top; under it an icon, a widely spaced grotesk title, grey copy and a small link.
notes: the visual is any node: a placeholder, a screenshot or live UI; it fades out towards the bottom
name: resend-feature-card

props.name: visual
props.description: what shows in the lit box (live UI, a screenshot or a placeholder)

props.name: icon
props.description: a small line icon (lucide) above the title

props.name: link
props.description: a small link under the copy

props.name: visualClassName
props.description: height of the visual box (defaults to 320px)
